body.name: oracle-conditional validated capacity search
body.construction: Conditional on a supplied interval oracle satisfying Definition \(\mathrm{interval\mbox{-}oracle}\), apply it to a fair dyadic branch-and-bound tree on \([-G,G]\).  At depth \(r\), bisect every surviving interval, evaluate every child and its midpoint at precision at least \(m_\epsilon+r\), retain a rational incumbent upper bound, and prune only intervals whose certified lower bound exceeds that incumbent.  If pruning has not already certified an objective gap at most \(\epsilon\), retain the full-level fallback partition through depth \(D_\epsilon\) and stop there.
